assets.name: sanctuary.v001
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production background painting asset for ARCANUM tarot mobile home scene. Portrait 1024x1536. NO UI, NO text, NO frame. Almost black charcoal and tarnished bronze, atmospheric density at very low contrast. An intimate ancient stone hollow, symmetrical opening with asymmetrical eroded layered rock fragments at extreme left and right edges; subtle scratched black parchment/mineral grain throughout, a barely visible rocky floor in the bottom 20%, upper central 70% empty deep darkness for separate celestial objects. Bottom center at x50% y82% a tiny warm antique-gold point illuminates a few stone ridges and dust, suggesting sacred light within darkness. No sky, no landscape horizon, no mountains, no buildings in center. Edges fade completely to near black #080706, NOT a rectangular painting border. Materials like an old astronomical copperplate and smoky dry pigment, refined detailed engraved painterly shadows, no generic fantasy castle. Extremely restrained lighting, 90% shadow. Composition will sit UNDER separately rendered thin orbit lines and a bronze crescent, so DO NOT draw moon, stars, circles, geometry, symbols or lettering. Closely matches the intimate dark rocky sanctuary behind the celestial axis in the LEFT phone of the supplied reference. Generate original asset, not a phone mockup.

assets.name: crescent.v001
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game UI art sprite, one isolated UPWARD-FACING thin crescent moon, both horns point UP symmetrically, like a shallow sacred bronze bowl. Transparent background including inside the crescent. Square 1024x1024, centered object occupies 65% of canvas width, ample transparent margin. Refined antique gold and oxidized bronze relief with engraved hairline etching, irregular pitted matte metal, warm rim catching candlelike light, shadowed interior surface. The crescent must be thin and delicate, not a thick bulky golden bowl, not a shiny 3D emoji, not a flat vector icon. Painterly engraved gothic manuscript material, tiny variations in gold/sand/bronze, realistic antique metal volume yet visually frontal and flat-facing camera. No chains, no jewelry hooks, no ornament below, no stars, no sun, no circles, no text, no landscape, no box, no background. Only the moon and very restrained warm close-edge light, preserve real alpha transparency. It will be displayed only 60px wide on an almost black ritual interface; silhouette must be unmistakable, luminosity refined and restrained.

assets.name: light-axis.v001
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE transparent atmosphere sprite for a premium dark occult mobile interface. Portrait composition 1024x1536 with real alpha transparent background. A thin vertical shaft of antique-gold dusty light down the exact center x50%. At y24% an exquisite small eight-point astronomical star with fine long needle rays, ivory central pinpoint and antique bronze engraved rays, star width 18% of canvas, vertical ray length 22%. Beneath star an extremely fine continuous luminous thread with drifting warm dust, ends in another tiny sharp glint at x50% y83%, with a narrow soft amber reflection extending horizontally only near that bottom glint. Most of canvas is empty transparent, luminosity localized, no neon bloom, no huge halos. Antique copperplate engraving meets sophisticated painterly lighting, sacred old material. NO moon, NO planets, NO rings, NO circular orbits, NO ground or rocks, NO text, NO UI, NO frame, NO background. This is a separate light-and-star layer to composite over dark stone artwork, NOT a complete illustration.
